newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Liang Shing places 117 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Liang Shing places 117 mln new shares.

text.p: Sport shoe maker Liang Shing (Holdings) Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to place 117 million new shares, representing 16.64 percent of its enlarged share capital, to third party investors at HK$0.38 per share.
The stake of controlling shareholder Ever First Investments Ltd will be diluted to 35.6 percent from 42.7 percent on completion of the deal, it said.
Net proceeds of about HK$43 million will be used to reduce debt and for working capital.
The company said its proforma net asset value per share was about HK$0.133 as at December 31, 1996.
Liang Shing shares were up HK$0.02 to HK$0.47 at midday.
